positional arguments:
  {autoupdate,cache,clean,completions,config,doctor,gc,hazmat,init-templatedir,install,install-hooks,list,migrate,migrate-config,run,sample-config,self,try-repo,uninstall,validate-config,validate-manifest,help,hook-impl}
    autoupdate          Auto-update snp config to the
                        latest repos' versions.
    cache               Inspect or clean snp's cache.
    clean               Clean out snp files.
    completions         Print a shell completion script.
    config              Print the merged configuration or
                        its JSON schema.
    doctor              Check snp, the hook scripts and
                        the cache for problems.
    gc                  Clean unused cached repos.
    hazmat              Composable tools for rare use in
                        hook `entry`.
    init-templatedir    Install hook script in a directory
                        intended for use with `git config
                        init.templateDir`.
    install             Install the snp script.
    install-hooks       Install hook environments for all
                        environments in the config file.
                        You may find `snp install
                        --install-hooks` more useful.
    list                List the hooks of the
                        configuration.
    migrate             Convert lefthook configurations or
                        switch pre-commit-hooks to and
                        from `repo: builtin`.
    migrate-config      Migrate list configuration to new
                        map configuration.
    run                 Run hooks.
    sample-config       Produce a sample .pre-commit-
                        config.yaml file
    self                Manage the snp installation.
    try-repo            Try the hooks in a repository,
                        useful for developing new hooks.
    uninstall           Uninstall the snp script.
    validate-config     Validate .pre-commit-config.yaml
                        files
    validate-manifest   Validate .pre-commit-hooks.yaml
                        files
    help                Show help for a specific command.

  --checkout-type CHECKOUT_TYPE
                        Indicates whether the checkout was a branch checkout
                        (changing branches, flag=1) or a file checkout
                        (retrieving a file from the index, flag=0).
  --is-squash-merge IS_SQUASH_MERGE
                        During a post-merge hook, indicates whether the merge
                        was a squash merge
  --rewrite-command REWRITE_COMMAND
                        During a post-rewrite hook, specifies the command that
                        invoked the rewrite
  -j, --jobs JOBS       Number of hooks to run in parallel (default: the
                        number of CPUs).
  --group GROUP         Run only hooks in this group; repeat to select hooks
                        in any of the groups. `@ungrouped` selects hooks
                        without groups.
  --require-group GROUP
                        Run only hooks in this group; repeat to require every
                        group.
  --no-group GROUP      Skip hooks in this group (repeatable; wins over
                        --group and --require-group).
  --no-fast-path        Run pre-commit-hooks in their Python environments
                        instead of snp's native implementations.
  --summary             Print a summary of the hook results at the end.
  --no-local-config     Ignore the local override file (.pre-commit-
                        config.local.yaml).
